intro: Commercial roofing does not have a price list, and any contractor who hands you one before getting on the roof is guessing. What a job costs is set by the square footage, the condition of the deck and insulation underneath, the membrane and insulation the building actually needs, the amount of sheet metal detail at the perimeter and penetrations, and how much of the work has to happen around your operations. We evaluate the roof, put the scope and the system spec in writing, and give you a number you can take to ownership or a board — including, where it is genuinely the honest answer, the repair number alongside the replacement number.
notes: Every system we install carries a manufacturer warranty, registered in your name. Ask us what the term is and what it covers before you sign anything — with anyone.
